description:
As a guest planning my next ride, I want to list only rides with a short wait, so I don't walk across the park to a long queue.

Add an optional `max_wait` query parameter (minutes) to `GET /rides`.

acceptance_criteria.text: GET /rides?max_wait=N returns only open rides whose current wait is N minutes or less.
GET /rides?max_wait=0 returns the open rides with no wait, and never returns closed rides.
Without max_wait, GET /rides lists every ride as before; a negative max_wait returns 422.
